definitions.explanation: the act of planting trees to create or restore forests

examples.japanese: {植林|しょくりん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To participate in tree planting activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植林|しょくりん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: To plant trees on the mountain and increase greenery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境保護|かんきょうほご}→環境保護：15308_kankyouhogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植林|しょくりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Tree planting is being promoted for environmental protection.

notes:
Compound of {植|しょく} (planting) + {林|りん} (forest/grove). Refers to the deliberate planting of trees to create or restore forested areas.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {植林|しょくりん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is intransitive in practice (the activity itself)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植林|しょくりん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to plant trees on a mountain

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {植林|しょくりん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: tree planting activities
- {植林|しょくりん}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: forestation project
- {植林|しょくりん}⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧: tree planting volunteer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伐採|ばっさい}→伐採：08435_bassai⟧: logging, felling (opposite concept)
- {造林|ぞうりん}: silviculture (more technical forestry term)
- {緑化|りょっか}: greening (broader concept including grass, gardens)

A key strategy for combating ⟦{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧ (global warming). Many Japanese companies sponsor {植林|しょくりん} programs as part of CSR activities.
